runtime_digest_definition: SHA256 of sorted App/ and Core/Sources/ paths, each path + NUL + fileSHA256 + newline
preserved_limits: Earlier unsuccessful runs are retained in local QA; only the listed current-source cases establish this result.
Simulator results do not prove physical frame rate,real-site speed,or actual favorites mutations.
repository_scope: Source,assets,and a bounded verification summary; no login data,raw phone diagnostics,signing certificates,or install packages.
